description: Advances: bw.signal.pipeline. Hooks run with cwd = repo root (commondir parent). When bw signal emit runs from a linked worktree, gate hooks that verify the tree (compile/test) silently operate on the primary checkout instead of the emitting worktree, and ancestry checks against HEAD see the wrong branch. Verified empirically. Fix: export the invocation directory (repo.CWD) as BW_SIGNAL_CALLER_CWD in the hook environment so worktree-aware gates can cd into the tree under test. Hook cwd stays repo root per bw.decision.signal_hook_io.

comments.text: Implemented: Pipeline.CallerCWD wired from repo.CWD at both emit and validate --run-hooks call sites; runWithEnv exports BW_SIGNAL_CALLER_CWD when non-empty. TestHookCallerCWDEnv asserts hook cwd stays RepoRoot while the env var carries the caller dir, and that empty CallerCWD leaves the var unset. docs/design.md, bw.decision.signal_hook_io, and signal_pipeline.spec.md (requirement caller_cwd_env + worktree scenario + verification entry) updated. Builder's three gates rewritten to cd $BW_SIGNAL_CALLER_CWD with same-repo worktree validation; gate-completed now checks branch==epic_branch and ancestry against the epic worktree HEAD, drops legacy scripts/preflight.sh; hook_timeout 45m→10m. Full go test ./... running.

title: Expose caller cwd to signal hooks as BW_SIGNAL_CALLER_CWD
